      FloatLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
                FloatLabel:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", textSpanish)
                FloatLabel:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", textEnglish)

                local pillV5 = nil
                if usePillV5 then
                    -- El color del texto lo maneja el diseno (blanco apagado / contraste del tema al encender)
                    FloatLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", nil)
                    FloatLabel:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
                    pillV5 = FloatingPillV5.Build(FloatingWindow, FloatingGlow, FloatLabel, floatStroke, hasLinkedSlider, hasDial)
                end
                if hasDial then
                    FloatingPillV5.BuildDial(FloatingWindow, FloatLabel, _dialList)
                end

                if hasLinkedSlider then
                    local sMin   = _linkedSliderRef._min or 0
                    local sMax   = _linkedSliderRef._max or 100
                    local sValue = math.clamp(_linkedSliderRef._value or sMin, sMin, sMax)

                    local SliderRow = mk("Frame", {
                        Parent = FloatingWindow,
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 34),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 36),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        ZIndex = 7,
                    })

                    local SValueLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
                        Parent = SliderRow,
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 16),
                        Position = UDim2.new(1, -44, 0, 0),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Text = tostring(math.floor(sValue * 100) / 100),
                        TextColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                        TextSize = 12,
                        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
                        ZIndex = 8,
                    })
                    SValueLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")

                    local STrack = mk("Frame", {
                        Parent = SliderRow,
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, -52, 0, 5),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 20),
                        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.AccentOff,
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        Active = true,
                        ZIndex = 7,
                    })
                    STrack:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "AccentOff")
                    corner(STrack, 2)

                    local SFill = mk("Frame", {
                        Parent = STrack,
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
                        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        ZIndex = 8,
                    })
                    SFill:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
                    corner(SFill, 2)

                    local SThumb = mk("Frame", {
                        Parent = SliderRow,
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 20),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 12),
                        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        Active = true,
                        ZIndex = 9,
                    })
                    SThumb:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
                    corner(SThumb, 7)
                    stroke(SThumb, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.7)

                    local function updateSliderVisual(percentage)
                        percentage = math.clamp(percentage, 0, 1)
                        local trackWidth = STrack.AbsoluteSize.X
                        SFill.Size = UDim2.new(percentage, 0, 1, 0)
                        SThumb.Position = UDim2.new(0, (trackWidth * percentage) - 7, 0, 12)
                    end

                    local initialPct = (sMax > sMin) and ((sValue - sMin) / (sMax - sMin)) or 0
                    task.defer(function() updateSliderVisual(initialPct) end)

                    local sDragging = false

                    local function applyDragAt(inputPos)
                        local relativeX = inputPos.X - STrack.AbsolutePosition.X
                        local trackWidth = STrack.AbsoluteSize.X
                        if trackWidth <= 0 then return end
                        local percentage = math.clamp(relativeX / trackWidth, 0, 1)
                        updateSliderVisual(percentage)
                        local newVal = sMin + (sMax - sMin) * percentage
                        SValueLabel.Text = tostring(math.floor(newVal * 100) / 100)
                        if _linkedSliderRef.Set then
                            _linkedSliderRef.Set(newVal)
                        end
                    end

                    local function beginDrag(input)
                        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                            sDragging = true
                            applyDragAt(input.Position)
                        end
                    end
                    STrack.InputBegan:Connect(beginDrag)
                    SThumb.InputBegan:Connect(beginDrag)

                    track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                        if sDragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                            applyDragAt(input.Position)
                        end
                    end))

                    track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                        if sDragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                            sDragging = false
                            playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
                        end
                    end))
                end

                local function updateFloatVisual(instant)
                    if pillV5 then
                        pillV5.Apply(state, instant == true)
                        FloatingPillV5.Studio.Paint(FloatingWindow, state, instant == true)
                        return
                    end
                    if state then
                        TweenService:Create(FloatingWindow, TweenInfo.new(0.15),
                            {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ToggleOn}):Play()
                    else
                        TweenService:Create(FloatingWindow, TweenInfo.new(0.15),
                            {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary}):Play()
                    end
                    FloatingPillV5.Studio.Paint(FloatingWindow, state, instant == true)
                end
                updateFloatVisual(true)

                local dragging = false
                local dragStart, startPos
                local dragMoved = false

                local FloatClick = mk("TextButton", {
                    Parent = FloatingWindow,
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Text = "",
                    AutoButtonColor = false,
                    Active = true,
                    Selectable = false,
                    ZIndex = 6
                })

                FloatClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    if dragging then return end
                    state = not state
                    playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
                    updateFloatVisual()
                    tog.SetValue(state)
                    pcall(cb, state)
                end)

                local function syncGlow()
                    if FloatingGlow and FloatingGlow.Parent then
                        FloatingGlow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(FloatingWindow.Size.X.Offset + 16, FloatingWindow.Size.Y.Offset + 12)
                        FloatingGlow.Position = UDim2.new(FloatingWindow.Position.X.Scale, FloatingWindow.Position.X.Offset - 8, FloatingWindow.Position.Y.Scale, FloatingWindow.Position.Y.Offset - 6)
                    end
                end
                syncGlow()
                track(FloatingWindow:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(syncGlow))


                local function clampFloatingWindow()
                    if not FloatingWindow or not FloatingWindow.Parent then return end

                    local viewport = Window.ScreenGui.AbsoluteSize
                    local windowSize = FloatingWindow.AbsoluteSize
                    if viewport.X <= 0 or viewport.Y <= 0 or windowSize.X <= 0 or windowSize.Y <= 0 then
                        return
                    end

                    local margin = 8
                    local pos = FloatingWindow.Position
                    local minX = margin - pos.X.Scale * viewport.X
                    local maxX = viewport.X - windowSize.X - margin - pos.X.Scale * viewport.X
                    local minY = margin - pos.Y.Scale * viewport.Y
                    local maxY = viewport.Y - windowSize.Y - margin - pos.Y.Scale * viewport.Y

                    local clampedX = maxX < minX and ((viewport.X - windowSize.X) / 2) - pos.X.Scale * viewport.X
                        or math.clamp(pos.X.Offset, minX, maxX)
                    local clampedY = maxY < minY and ((viewport.Y - windowSize.Y) / 2) - pos.Y.Scale * viewport.Y
                        or math.clamp(pos.Y.Offset, minY, maxY)

                    if clampedX ~= pos.X.Offset or clampedY ~= pos.Y.Offset then
                        FloatingWindow.Position = UDim2.new(pos.X.Scale, clampedX, pos.Y.Scale, clampedY)
                    end
                end

                clampFloatingWindow()
                track(Window.ScreenGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(clampFloatingWindow))

                FloatClick.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) and not isLocked then
                        dragging = false
                        dragMoved = false
                        dragStart = input.Position
                        startPos = FloatingWindow.Position
                    end
                end)

                track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                    if dragStart and not isLocked and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                        if delta.Magnitude > 4 then
                            dragging = true
                            dragMoved = true
                            FloatingWindow.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
                            clampFloatingWindow()
                        end
                    end
                end))

                track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        task.defer(function() dragging = false end)
                        dragStart = nil
                    end
                end))

                table.insert(Window.FloatingToggles, {
                    Window = FloatingWindow,
                    Name = displayText,
                    RefreshVisual = updateFloatVisual,
                    ClampPosition = clampFloatingWindow,
                })
                FloatingPillV5.Studio.Attach(FloatingWindow, FloatingGlow, FloatLabel, favId, function() return state end, {
                    Refresh = function() updateFloatVisual(true) end,
                })
            end
            
            
            toggleFloating = function()
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.6)
                if not isFloating then
                    isFloating = true
                    createFloatingWindow()
                    DetachBtn.Text = "←"
                else
                    isFloating = false
                    if animationConnection then
                        animationConnection:Disconnect()
                        animationConnection = nil
                    end
                    if FloatingWindow then
                        FloatingWindow:Destroy()
                        FloatingWindow = nil
                    end
                    if FloatingGlow then
                        FloatingGlow:Destroy()
                        FloatingGlow = nil
                    end
                    DetachBtn.Text = "↗"
                    isLocked = false
                    PinBtn.Image = "rbxassetid://83537941312438"
                end
                for _, refresh in ipairs(favoriteControlRefreshers) do pcall(refresh) end
            end
            
            toggleLock = function()
                if not isFloating then return end
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
                isLocked = not isLocked
                if isLocked then FloatPos.Save(favId, FloatingWindow, Window.ScreenGui) else FloatPos.SetLocked(favId, false) end
                PinBtn.Image = isLocked
                    and "rbxassetid://91959170037380"
                    or  "rbxassetid://83537941312438"
                for _, refresh in ipairs(favoriteControlRefreshers) do pcall(refresh) end
            end
            DetachBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleFloating)
            PinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleLock)

            syncFavoriteRow()

            resetScrollTop(TabPage)

            return {
                SetValue = function(value)
                    state = value
                    tog.SetValue(value)
                    if favRow and favRow.SetValue then
                        favRow.SetValue(value)
                    end
                    if FloatingWindow then
                        for _, ft in ipairs(Window.FloatingToggles) do
                            if ft.Window == FloatingWindow then
                                pcall(ft.RefreshVisual)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end,
                GetValue = function()
                    return state
                end,
                -- Tambor de valores en la pildora: entries = { { Slider = <CreateSlider>, Tag = "VEL" }, ... }
                -- Si ya esta flotando, se rehace la pildora en el mismo lugar para mostrar el tambor.
                LinkDial = function(entries)
                    _dialList = (type(entries) == "table" and #entries > 0) and entries or nil
                    if isFloating and FloatingWindow then
                        local keepPos = FloatingWindow.Position
                        if animationConnection then
                            animationConnection:Disconnect()
                            animationConnection = nil
                        end
                        FloatingWindow:Destroy()
                        FloatingWindow = nil
                        if FloatingGlow then
                            FloatingGlow:Destroy()
                            FloatingGlow = nil
                        end
                        createFloatingWindow()
                        if FloatingWindow then
                            FloatingWindow.Position = keepPos
                        end
                    end
                end,
                Holder = Holder,
                Switch = HolderSwitch,
                Click = HolderClick,
            }
        end


        function Tab:CreateCombinedToggle(textSpanish, textEnglishOrDefault)
            local textEnglish = type(textEnglishOrDefault) == "string" and textEnglishOrDefault or textSpanish
            FloatingPillV5.Studio.Register("combo::" .. nameSpanish .. "::" .. textSpanish, textSpanish, textEnglish, nameSpanish, "Combo")
            local displayText = GetText(textSpanish, textEnglish)
            local state = false
            local isFloating = false
            local isLocked = false

            local Holder = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = TabPage,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 80),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.7,
                ZIndex = 9
            })
            Holder:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
            corner(Holder, 10)
            local ComboStroke = stroke(Holder, Theme.Accent, 1.5, 0.15)
            RowKit.Card(Holder)
            ComboStroke:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")

            local AccentBar = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 56),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -28),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                ZIndex = 10
            })
            AccentBar:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
            corner(AccentBar, 999)

            local BadgeIcon = mk("ImageLabel", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 10),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Image = "rbxassetid://114334068728895",
                ImageColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                ZIndex = 10
            })
            BadgeIcon:SetAttribute("ThemeImageRole", "Accent")

            local LabelTxt = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 18),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 8),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = displayText,
                TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
                TextSize = 13,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                ZIndex = 10
            })
            LabelTxt:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")

            local ComboLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 22),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 30),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = GetText("Vacío", "Empty"),
                TextColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 16,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                ZIndex = 10
            })
            ComboLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Accent")

            local DetachBtn = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -130, 0, 18),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                Text = "↗",
                TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 13,
                ZIndex = 15
            })
            corner(DetachBtn, 6)
            RowKit.Control(DetachBtn, true)

            local PinBtn = mk("ImageButton", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -98, 0, 18),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                Image = "rbxassetid://83537941312438",
                ImageColor3 = Theme.Text,
                ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch,
                ZIndex = 15
            })
            corner(PinBtn, 6)
            stroke(PinBtn, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.5)
            RowKit.Control(PinBtn)

            local Switch = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 28),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -66, 0, 18),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.AccentOff,
                ZIndex = 10
            })
            Switch:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "AccentOff")
            corner(Switch, 999)

            local Knob = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Switch,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -12),
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
                ZIndex = 12
            })
            corner(Knob, 999)

            local Click = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "",
                ZIndex = 13
            })

            local function applyVisual(newState, animate)
                local knobPos = newState and UDim2.new(1, -26, 0.5, -12) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -12)
                local trackColor = newState and Theme.Accent or Theme.AccentOff
                if animate then
                    TweenService:Create(Knob, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = knobPos}):Play()
                    TweenService:Create(Switch, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundColor3 = trackColor}):Play()
                else
                    Knob.Position = knobPos
                    Switch.BackgroundColor3 = trackColor
                end
                Switch:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", newState and "Accent" or "AccentOff")
            end

            local function fireComboMembers(newState)
                for _, member in ipairs(Window.ComboMembers) do
                    pcall(member.SetState, newState)
                end
            end

            Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                state = not state
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
                applyVisual(state, true)
                fireComboMembers(state)
            end)

            local FloatingWindow = nil
            local FloatingGlow = nil

            local function createFloatingWindow()
                local floatStyle    = SavedConfig.FloatingToggleStyle or "Pill"
                local isCircleStyle = (floatStyle == "Circle")
                local floatW = isCircleStyle and 64 or 200
                local floatH = isCircleStyle and 64 or 36

                FloatingGlow = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = Window.ScreenGui,
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(216, 48),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -108, 0.5, -24),
                    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ZIndex = 3
                })
                corner(FloatingGlow, 999)

                FloatingWindow = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = Window.ScreenGui,
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(floatW, floatH),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -floatW/2, 0.5, -floatH/2),
                    BackgroundColor3 = isCircleStyle and Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 26) or Theme.Secondary,
                    BackgroundTransparency = isCircleStyle and 0.55 or 0.30,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Active = true,
                    Selectable = false,
                    ZIndex = 4
                })
                FloatPos.Apply("combo::" .. nameSpanish .. "::" .. textSpanish, FloatingWindow)
                if FloatPos.IsLocked("combo::" .. nameSpanish .. "::" .. textSpanish) then
                    isLocked = true
                    PinBtn.Image = "rbxassetid://91959170037380"
                end
                FloatingWindow:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
                FloatingWindow:SetAttribute("SupportsFloatStyle", true)
                corner(FloatingWindow, 999)

                if not isCircleStyle then
                    mk("UIGradient", {
                        Color = ColorSequence.new({
                            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,   Color3.fromRGB(180, 185, 200)),
                            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(240, 243, 250)),
                            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,   Color3.fromRGB(180, 185, 200)),
                        }),
                        Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,   0.45),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.15),
                            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,   0.45),
                        }),
                        Rotation = 90,
                    }, FloatingWindow)
                end

                stroke(FloatingWindow, Theme.Accent, isCircleStyle and 3 or 2.5, 0.20)
                buildAnimatedBorder(FloatingWindow, Theme.Border, UDim.new(1, 0), true)

                local FloatLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
                    Parent = FloatingWindow,
                    Size = isCircleStyle and UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -24) or UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, 0),
                    Position = isCircleStyle and UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12) or UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Text = ComboLabel.Text,
                    TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
                    TextSize = isCircleStyle and 11 or 21,
                    TextWrapped = isCircleStyle,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                    TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
                    TextTruncate = isCircleStyle and Enum.TextTruncate.None or Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                    ZIndex = 5,
                })
                FloatLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
                if Window.ComboSlot then
                    Window.ComboSlot.FloatLabel = FloatLabel
                end

                local function updateFloatVisual()
                    if state then
                        TweenService:Create(FloatingWindow, TweenInfo.new(0.15),
                            {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.ToggleOn}):Play()
                    else
                        TweenService:Create(FloatingWindow, TweenInfo.new(0.15),
                            {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary}):Play()
                    end
                    FloatingPillV5.Studio.Paint(FloatingWindow, state, false)
                end
                updateFloatVisual()

                local dragging = false
                local dragStart, startPos
                local dragMoved = false

                local FloatClick = mk("TextButton", {
                    Parent = FloatingWindow,
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Text = "",
                    AutoButtonColor = false,
                    Active = true,
                    Selectable = false,
                    ZIndex = 6
                })

                FloatClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    if dragging then return end
                    state = not state
                    playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
                    updateFloatVisual()
                    applyVisual(state, true)
                    fireComboMembers(state)
                end)

                local function syncGlow()
                    if FloatingGlow and FloatingGlow.Parent then
                        FloatingGlow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(FloatingWindow.Size.X.Offset + 16, FloatingWindow.Size.Y.Offset + 12)
                        FloatingGlow.Position = UDim2.new(FloatingWindow.Position.X.Scale, FloatingWindow.Position.X.Offset - 8, FloatingWindow.Position.Y.Scale, FloatingWindow.Position.Y.Offset - 6)
                    end
                end
                syncGlow()
                track(FloatingWindow:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(syncGlow))

                local function clampFloatingWindow()
                    if not FloatingWindow or not FloatingWindow.Parent then return end

                    local viewport = Window.ScreenGui.AbsoluteSize
                    local windowSize = FloatingWindow.AbsoluteSize
                    if viewport.X <= 0 or viewport.Y <= 0 or windowSize.X <= 0 or windowSize.Y <= 0 then
                        return
                    end

                    local margin = 8
                    local pos = FloatingWindow.Position
                    local minX = margin - pos.X.Scale * viewport.X
                    local maxX = viewport.X - windowSize.X - margin - pos.X.Scale * viewport.X
                    local minY = margin - pos.Y.Scale * viewport.Y
                    local maxY = viewport.Y - windowSize.Y - margin - pos.Y.Scale * viewport.Y

                    local clampedX = maxX < minX and ((viewport.X - windowSize.X) / 2) - pos.X.Scale * viewport.X
                        or math.clamp(pos.X.Offset, minX, maxX)
                    local clampedY = maxY < minY and ((viewport.Y - windowSize.Y) / 2) - pos.Y.Scale * viewport.Y
                        or math.clamp(pos.Y.Offset, minY, maxY)

                    if clampedX ~= pos.X.Offset or clampedY ~= pos.Y.Offset then
                        FloatingWindow.Position = UDim2.new(pos.X.Scale, clampedX, pos.Y.Scale, clampedY)
                    end
                end

                clampFloatingWindow()
                track(Window.ScreenGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(clampFloatingWindow))

                FloatClick.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) and not isLocked then
                        dragging = false
                        dragMoved = false
                        dragStart = input.Position
                        startPos = FloatingWindow.Position
                    end
                end)

                track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                    if dragStart and not isLocked and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                        if delta.Magnitude > 4 then
                            dragging = true
                            dragMoved = true
                            FloatingWindow.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
                            clampFloatingWindow()
                        end
                    end
                end))

                track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        task.defer(function() dragging = false end)
                        dragStart = nil
                    end
                end))

                table.insert(Window.FloatingToggles, {
                    Window = FloatingWindow,
                    Name = displayText,
                    RefreshVisual = updateFloatVisual,
                    ClampPosition = clampFloatingWindow,
                })
                FloatingPillV5.Studio.Attach(FloatingWindow, FloatingGlow, FloatLabel, "combo::" .. nameSpanish .. "::" .. textSpanish, function() return state end, {
                    Refresh = updateFloatVisual,
                })
            end

            local toggleFloating = function()
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.6)
                if not isFloating then
                    isFloating = true
                    createFloatingWindow()
                    DetachBtn.Text = "←"
                else
                    isFloating = false
                    if FloatingWindow then
                        FloatingWindow:Destroy()
                        FloatingWindow = nil
                    end
                    if FloatingGlow then
                        FloatingGlow:Destroy()
                        FloatingGlow = nil
                    end
                    if Window.ComboSlot then
                        Window.ComboSlot.FloatLabel = nil
                    end
                    DetachBtn.Text = "↗"
                    isLocked = false
                    PinBtn.Image = "rbxassetid://83537941312438"
                end
            end

            local toggleLock = function()
                if not isFloating then return end
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
                isLocked = not isLocked
                if isLocked then FloatPos.Save("combo::" .. nameSpanish .. "::" .. textSpanish, FloatingWindow, Window.ScreenGui) else FloatPos.SetLocked("combo::" .. nameSpanish .. "::" .. textSpanish, false) end
                PinBtn.Image = isLocked
                    and "rbxassetid://91959170037380"
                    or  "rbxassetid://83537941312438"
            end
            DetachBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleFloating)
            PinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleLock)

            Window.ComboSlot = {
                Holder = Holder,
                Label = ComboLabel,
            }
            Window.RefreshComboLabel()

            resetScrollTop(TabPage)

            return {
                Holder = Holder,
                Switch = Switch,
            }
        end

        function Tab:CreateToggle(textSpanish, textEnglishOrDefault, defaultOrCallback, callback, isMirror, creditInfo)
            local textEnglish = textSpanish
            local default, cb

            if type(textEnglishOrDefault) == "string" then
                textEnglish = textEnglishOrDefault
                default = defaultOrCallback
                cb = callback
            else
                default = textEnglishOrDefault
                cb = defaultOrCallback
            end

            local displayText = GetText(textSpanish, textEnglish)
            local state = default or false

            local credit   = type(creditInfo) == "table" and creditInfo or nil
            local hasBadge = credit and (credit.imageId or credit.name)
            local hasDesc  = credit and type(credit.description) == "string" and #credit.description > 0
            local holderH  = (hasDesc and hasBadge) and 110 or (hasDesc or hasBadge) and 90 or 64
            local textOffW = hasBadge and -164 or -90

            local Holder = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = TabPage,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, holderH),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.78,
                ZIndex = 9
            })
            Holder:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
            corner(Holder, 10)
            local HolderStroke = stroke(Holder, state and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.Stroke, 1, state and 0.35 or 0.55)
            HolderStroke:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", state and "ToggleOn" or "Stroke")
            RowKit.Card(Holder)

            local AccentBar = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 36),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -18),
                BackgroundColor3 = state and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.AccentOff,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0,
                ZIndex = 10
            })
            AccentBar:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", state and "ToggleOn" or "AccentOff")
            corner(AccentBar, 999)

            local LabelTxt = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, textOffW, 0, 22),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 13),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = displayText,
                TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
                TextSize = 15,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                ZIndex = 10
            })
            LabelTxt:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
            LabelTxt:SetAttribute("TextSpanish", textSpanish)
            LabelTxt:SetAttribute("TextEnglish", textEnglish)

            local StateLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, textOffW, 0, 16),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 36),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "●  " .. (state and GetText("Activado", "Enabled") or GetText("Desactivado", "Disabled")),
                TextColor3 = state and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.TextDim,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
                TextSize = 11,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                Visible = not hasDesc,
                ZIndex = 10
            })
            StateLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", state and "ToggleOn" or "TextDim")
            RowKit.Chip(StateLabel, state and "ToggleOn" or "AccentOff")
            StateLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 38)

            if hasDesc then
                mk("TextLabel", {
                    Parent = Holder,
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, textOffW, 1, -50),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 36),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Text = credit.description,
                    TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                    Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
                    TextSize = 12,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                    TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
                    TextWrapped = true,
                    ZIndex = 10
                }):SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
            end

            local Switch = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 28),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -66, 0.5, -14),
                BackgroundColor3 = state and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.AccentOff,
                ZIndex = 10
            })
            Switch:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", state and "ToggleOn" or "AccentOff")
            corner(Switch, 999)
            stroke(Switch, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.6)

            local TrackShadow = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Switch,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 1),
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.82,
                ZIndex = 10
            })
            corner(TrackShadow, 999)

            local KnobShadow = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Switch,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24),
                Position = state and UDim2.new(1, -27, 0.5, -11) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -11),
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.55,
                ZIndex = 11
            })
            corner(KnobShadow, 999)

            local Knob = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Switch,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24),
                Position = state and UDim2.new(1, -26, 0.5, -12) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -12),
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
                ZIndex = 12
            })
            corner(Knob, 999)

            local Click = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "",
                ZIndex = 13
            })

            if hasBadge then
                local credAvatarSize = 60
                local credGap        = 10
                local credNameH      = 18
                local credBlockH     = credAvatarSize + credGap + credNameH
                local credTopPad     = math.max(0, (holderH - credBlockH) / 2)
                local credAvatarTop  = credTopPad
                local credNameTop    = credTopPad + credAvatarSize + credGap

                if credit.imageId then
                    local avatarRing = mk("Frame", {
                        Parent = Holder,
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, credAvatarSize, 0, credAvatarSize),
                        Position = UDim2.new(1, -134, 0, credAvatarTop),
                        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                        ZIndex = 10
                    })
                    avatarRing:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
                    corner(avatarRing, 999)
                    stroke(avatarRing, Theme.Stroke, 2.5, 0.30)

                    local avatarImg = mk("ImageLabel", {
                        Parent = avatarRing,
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 1, -4),
                        Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, 2),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Image = credit.imageId,
                        ZIndex = 11
                    })
                    corner(avatarImg, 999)
                end

                if credit.name then
                    mk("TextLabel", {
                        Parent = Holder,
                        Size = UDim2.new(0, 78, 0, credNameH),
                        Position = UDim2.new(1, -142, 0, credNameTop),
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Text = credit.name,
                        TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                        TextSize = 14,
                        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                        ZIndex = 10
                    }):SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
                end
            end

            local knobOFF       = UDim2.new(0, 2,  0.5, -12)
            local knobON        = UDim2.new(1, -26, 0.5, -12)
            local shadowOFF     = UDim2.new(0, 3,  0.5, -11)
            local shadowON      = UDim2.new(1, -27, 0.5, -11)
            local knobNormal    = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24)
            local knobSquishON  = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 22)
            local knobSquishOFF = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 22)

            local function applyVisual(newState, animate)
                local t = animate and 0.18 or 0
                local ti = TweenInfo.new(t, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

                local trackColor = newState and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.AccentOff
                local barColor   = newState and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.AccentOff
                TweenService:Create(Switch,     ti, {BackgroundColor3 = trackColor}):Play()
                TweenService:Create(AccentBar,  ti, {BackgroundColor3 = barColor}):Play()
                Switch:SetAttribute("ThemeRole",    newState and "ToggleOn" or "AccentOff")
                AccentBar:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", newState and "ToggleOn" or "AccentOff")

                local stateText  = "●  " .. (newState and GetText("Activado", "Enabled") or GetText("Desactivado", "Disabled"))
                local stateColor = newState and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.TextDim
                StateLabel.Text = stateText
                TweenService:Create(StateLabel, ti, {TextColor3 = stateColor, BackgroundColor3 = newState and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.AccentOff}):Play()
                StateLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", newState and "ToggleOn" or "TextDim")
                StateLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", newState and "ToggleOn" or "AccentOff")
                TweenService:Create(HolderStroke, ti, {Color = newState and Theme.ToggleOn or Theme.Stroke, Transparency = newState and 0.35 or 0.55}):Play()
                HolderStroke:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", newState and "ToggleOn" or "Stroke")

                if animate then
                    local squishSize = newState and knobSquishON or knobSquishOFF
                    TweenService:Create(Knob,       TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                        {Size = squishSize}):Play()
                    task.delay(0.08, function()
                        TweenService:Create(Knob,       ti, {Size = knobNormal,
                            Position = newState and knobON or knobOFF}):Play()
                        TweenService:Create(KnobShadow, ti, {Position = newState and shadowON or shadowOFF}):Play()
                    end)
                else
                    Knob.Size     = knobNormal
